en-US.description:
Recreated the old-fashioned way, even crispier and tastier #GwangcheonGim
Today, we even went on a factory tour~

When it comes to seaweed... you only knew about #traditional seaweed #green laver #myeongran seaweed, right?

That's not it! This is it! From sweet seaweed that will captivate children's taste buds
to spicy seaweed that relieves stress!

Gim is definitely #Gwangcheon~~~^^b~~~
